artworks.title: Edward Lyttelton, Baron of Mounslow
artworks.artist: Robert Williams after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person, facing slightly to the right and looking straight ahead. The individual has distinct facial features with a mustache and a small goatee, and curly hair reaching the ears, partially covered by a cap. They are wearing a decorative outfit including a ruffled high collar or ruff, a adorned robe, and a chain of office on their shoulders. The background is a plain, dark tone.

artworks.title: Cardinal Carolus Madrucius
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man turned slightly to his left. His facial features include a prominent nose and a neatly trimmed mustache and beard. He has a solemn expression. The man's head is covered with a distinctive, tall cap suggesting clerical attire, and he wears a collar around his neck. His upper body is dressed in a buttoned cloak or robe. He is not holding any objects, and no visible jewelry is present. The background is plain with detailed line work, and the portrait is framed within an oval beaded border with Latin text identifying the individual as a reverend and illustrious cardinal. Beneath the oval, there is additional decorative text enclosed within an ornate frame featuring cherubic faces at the corners.

artworks.title: Doctor Francois Maelson
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, including a mustache and short, curly hair. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a high ruffled collar, a buttoned coat with patterned fabric, and a decorative bracelet on his wrist. He is holding a rolled document or scroll and the background has a plain backdrop with horizontal lines. At the top, there is a coat of arms, and below is an inscription identifying him as "Doctor Francois Maelson," along with additional text in another language.

artworks.title: Mehmed II, Sultan of Turkey
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up, seated and facing slightly to his right. He has a mustache and a small, pointed beard. His hair is covered by a turban adorned with a decorative jewel. He is wearing a patterned robe with buttons and a high collar. The border around him has inscriptions, crescent moons, a sword, and a flail. The background is shaded with a line pattern, contrasting the central figure. The bottom part of the image contains a block of text in Latin.

artworks.title: Mehmed II, Sultan of Turkey
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man's upper body facing slightly to his right. He is depicted in formal attire and appears composed. The man has distinct facial features, including a nose, beard, moustache, and expressive eyes. He wears a large turban with a decorative pin. His intricate tunic features decorative buttons. The background has a crosshatched pattern and radiating lines from the man's head. The image is framed by an oval border with inscriptions and symbols on the sides. Below the image, there is an inscription in a script-style font.

artworks.title: Antoine le Maitre
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body turned slightly to the right, with his face in profile. He has defined facial features, long curly hair, and wears a cap. He is dressed in a dark, formal garment, possibly a cassock, with a broad collar and buttons. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed with a decorative border. Below the portrait is an emblem or coat of arms with three lions. The background has shaded horizontal lines. The inscription "Francis Kettle fecit" is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Charles von Mansfeld
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is depicted in a three-quarter pose, with his body slightly turned to the viewer's left while his head faces forward. The man has a well-groomed beard and mustache, with short, neatly styled hair. He wears an elaborate, intricately detailed armored suit with decorative engravings, and a high ruffled collar adding to the opulence of his attire. In his left hand, he holds a helmet adorned with ornate designs. The background features a hilly landscape with various military activities depicted, including tents, soldiers, and a fortified structure. An insignia with a knight figure is present in the upper right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Ernest, Count of Mansfeld
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper body of a man named ERNESTUS MANSFELT. He is facing slightly left, smiling subtly, with sharp eyes, a pointed goatee, and neatly combed, wavy hair. He wears traditional attire with a lace-trimmed collar, a buttoned doublet, and a draped cloak over his shoulder. Ornate scrollwork surrounds the portrait, set against a textured, monochromatic background.

artworks.title: Peter Ernst, Furst von Mansfeld
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body, positioned facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a high forehead, arched eyebrows, eyes, a pointed nose, and a mustache. His hair is short and receding. He is dressed in a garment with a high ruffled collar and a decorated chest piece. The sleeves of his outfit have decorative braids or stitching. The portrait is encased in an oval frame, and the background has finely lined shading. At the base of the oval frame, there is a plaque reading "Petrus Ernestus Graef Van Mansfeldt" on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Margaret, Wife of Philip III of Spain
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman's head, neck, and shoulders. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to the right. Her facial features include large eyes, arched eyebrows, a delicate nose, and full lips. Her hair is styled high and is adorned with a crown-like accessory and flowers. She is wearing an elaborate ruff with intricate patterns around her neck. The engraving's background is plain, highlighting the subject and the ornamental details of her attire. An inscription encircles the image, providing a textual border.

artworks.title: Margaret, Wife of Philip III of Spain
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait focusing on the upper body of a person, specifically from the chest and above. The individual is positioned facing forward and is centered within an ornate oval frame. The person's facial features include a long, narrow face, slightly pursed lips, and large eyes. Their hair is styled in a high updo with intricate braiding and adornments, featuring a decorative crown-like headpiece. They are wearing an elaborate garment with intricate embroidery and decorative elements. A large, ornate lace ruff encircles their neck. The person is adorned with jewelry, including earrings and several necklaces, one of which features a cross motif. The background within the oval frame is plain, while the exterior features engraved lines, creating a textured effect. The text "MARGARETA D. G. PHILIPPI III..." is inscribed around the frame.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Hungary
artworks.artist: Karel van Sichem after Christoffel van Sichem I
artworks.description: This image shows a full-length portrait of a woman standing in a slightly angled position, facing to the right of the frame. Her left hand is extended to her side, pointing towards a book resting on a surface, and her right hand is resting by her waist. She has a composed expression on her face, with defined features and a small smile. Her hair is mostly covered by a headpiece that matches her somber and elaborate outfit. She is dressed in a richly adorned gown with intricate patterns and a fur-lined coat. The woman is wearing a pendant and a beaded chain, and a ring is visible on her right hand. The background depicts an architectural setting with a castle and rocky terrain, giving a sense of grandeur and historical context to the portrait.

artworks.title: Maria of Austria, Infanta of Spain
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a portrait of a young woman. She is shown from the shoulders up, facing forward with a direct gaze. Her features include large eyes, a small nose, and a slightly pursed mouth. Her hair is light and curly, styled closely to her head, with a thin headband. She wears a garment with a lace ruff collar, intricate patterns, and textures. Around her shoulders are decorative elements. The woman wears earrings and the background has detailed hatching. The image is bordered by an oval frame with inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: Princess Maria, Daughter of Emanuel, King of Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman displayed within an ornate oval border. She is facing slightly to her left, with her hands folded in front holding a small flower. Her facial features include almond-shaped eyes, arched eyebrows, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled intricately with jewels and framed by a decorative hairpiece. She wears a historical gown with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and decorative buttons on the bodice. She also wears jewelry and the background features a stippled pattern. Surrounding text outside the frame indicates her identity and status.

artworks.title: Princess Maria Magdalen
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to the right. The woman has delicate facial features, short curly hair, and is wearing a formal gown with intricate designs and a ruffled collar. She is adorned with jewelry and the background features decorative elements and text.

artworks.title: Richard Martin
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the waist up, seated and slightly turned to one side. He has a neutral expression with a hint of a smile, a full beard, and wavy hair. He wears a detailed 17th-century outfit with a lace ruff collar and a patterned doublet. One of his hands rests on his lap. The background features an ornate frame forming an oval shape around him, with scrolls and a coat of arms above his head. Below, there is a block of text with decorative elements, all against a plain background.

artworks.title: Queen Mary of England
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile portrait of a person facing left. The person has a long face with distinct features, wearing a decorated headdress and ornate clothing with floral designs. They wear a brooch on their chest. The frame around the figure features floral elements, a goat's head at the top, and griffin-like creatures at the bottom. The background has a textured pattern with inscriptions around the oval border. The image is in a detailed, monochromatic engraving style.

artworks.title: Mariae, D.G. Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Reginae (Mary I)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to the left but looks directly at the viewer. She has solemn facial features with defined cheekbones and jawline, wavy hair under a formal headdress, and is dressed in elaborate noble clothing with fur accents. She holds a rolled document in her right hand. The background features an ornate frame with Latin inscriptions and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Mariae, D.G. Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Reginae (Mary I)
artworks.description: The image is a waist-up portrait of a woman seated in a regal position, facing the viewer. Her facial features are sharp and defined, with expressive eyes, a straight nose, and neutral expression. Her hair is styled tightly under a decorative headdress adorned with pearls and lace trim. She wears an ornate gown with fur trim along the collar and sleeves, embroidered with intricate patterns. One hand is holding a book or pamphlet. The background features an intricately patterned arch with Latin inscriptions framing her figure. The image is stylized with engraving details, typical of a formal portrait from a historical period.

artworks.title: Queen Mary of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person shown from the upper half. The individual faces forward with a serious expression, featuring detailed facial characteristics such as a high forehead and prominent cheekbones. The person's hair is styled close to the head and adorned with a decorative headpiece. They are dressed in a high-collared garment with rich textures, including a ruffled collar, an ornate brooch, and a necklace indicating high status. The background consists of an ornate frame with scrollwork and Latin inscriptions, including "VERITAS TEMPORIS FILIA" at the bottom. The engraving is enclosed within an oval shape surrounded by intricate decorative elements.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scotts
artworks.description: The image displays a woman seated in an ornate chair. She is facing slightly to the side, with one hand near her chest and the other on her lap. She has soft facial features, curly shoulder-length hair, and wears a detailed crown and lavish clothing with pearls, embroidery, and fur. The background includes a tapestry depicting a classical scene.

artworks.title: Mary of Guise
artworks.description: The person in the image is depicted from the waist up, seated in a regal position. They have a serene facial expression with defined features, including arched eyebrows and a small mouth. Their hair is styled into curls framed by a headdress adorned with pearls. The individual wears an elaborate gown with intricate patterns, embellishments, lace, and embroidery. The sleeves are voluminous with lace ruffles, and the bodice is structured with a high lace collar. They wear a necklace and rings and hold a chain or jewelry. The background shows a landscape with a tree, architectural structures, and hills with water in the distance.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, standing with her left hand raised and right hand at her waist. She has a pronounced nose, styled hair, and is dressed in an ornate gown with detailed designs, a high collar, puffed shoulders, and intricate jewelry. The background features a curtain and a heraldic emblem with a lion in the upper left corner, hinting at a royal or noble setting.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a woman standing in a profile view facing left. She is poised elegantly, with her left hand hanging by her side and her right hand slightly raised. Her facial features are finely detailed, with a straight nose and a serene expression. Her hair is styled and adorned with a decorative headdress or headpiece. The woman wears a richly detailed dress with an elaborate pattern, accented with pearls or gemstones. A choker style ornament is visible around her neck. The scene includes a large curtain on the right side, suggesting an interior setting. At the top left, there is a diamond-shaped emblem with a lion topped with a crown.
